name: Rigged Cubby
disable: DC 20 Thievery check to cut the string without setting off the trap

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches the sickle in the cubby

---

Effect The heavy bricks above the cubby collapse, leaving the sickle unscathed but dealing 4d6+10 bludgeoning damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save save) to the triggering creature.

text: A hidden string connected to precariously stacked bricks causes the cubby to collapse in on itself when the string is pulled.
